title: Atlas 2 blind item
description: What a reviewer sees. Deliberately contains no class, no strength, no citations, no evidence, no record id, and no similarity scores. If any of those appear, the item has leaked.

item_id.description: Opaque, stable, and carrying no class information. Never the source record id.

math_object.description: The mathematical object. Say what it is, not which problem it comes from.

math_invariant.description: The invariant being tracked on the mathematical side.

transfer_operator.description: The claimed mechanism carrying one side to the other. Named 'operator' by convention; may in fact be a map, a correspondence, a procedure or a number. The vagueness is under test, not corrected here.

breakdown_boundary.description: Where the correspondence is said to fail.

examples.math_object: Maximum size of a Sidon subset of {1,...,N}
examples.math_invariant: All pairwise sums a+b are distinct for a != b
examples.physics_invariant: No two range-velocity pairs return an identical signal
examples.transfer_operator: Shannon sum-channel capacity ~ sqrt(N); the Singer construction attains this bound exactly
examples.breakdown_boundary: Breaks when Doppler is considered: the mathematics is a density in {1,...,N}, while the physics adds a velocity dimension absent from the Sidon problem
